issues.description: Return type is 'Promise<any>' which defeats TypeScript's type checking and can hide bugs

issues.description: No error handling for failed HTTP requests or JSON parsing. If fetch fails or response is invalid, the function will throw an unhandled exception
issues.suggestion: Add try-catch block and handle network errors, HTTP error status codes, and JSON parsing failures. Check response.ok before calling .json()

issues.description: No validation of response status code. Even 4xx/5xx responses will attempt JSON parsing, potentially exposing error details

issues.description: No timeout specified for fetch request. Long-hanging requests can block execution indefinitely
issues.suggestion: Implement timeout using AbortController: 'const controller = new AbortController(); const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);'

issues.description: No URL validation. Accepts any string including potentially malicious or invalid URLs

issues.description: No JSDoc comments explaining function parameters, return types, or possible exceptions

issues.description: Month value is not zero-padded. getMonth() returns 0-11, and adding 1 gives 1-12, but single-digit months should be padded with leading zeros for ISO 8601 compliance (e.g., '2024-01-05' not '2024-1-5').

issues.description: Day value is not zero-padded. Single-digit days should be padded for consistency with ISO 8601 format.
issues.suggestion: Pad day value to two digits using String.padStart(2, '0')

issues.description: Using string concatenation with '+' operator. While functional, template literals are more readable and performant in modern JavaScript.
issues.suggestion: Use template literal: return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;`

recommendations.description: Replace 'any' type with specific types and generics. Functions should have explicit return type annotations to enable TypeScript type checking and prevent bugs.

Add comprehensive test suites for all functions. Both files have 0% test coverage with critical gaps in success paths, error scenarios, and edge cases. All exported functions must have test coverage before production.
Fix critical bug in formatDate() function in utils.ts - the month variable is calculated but never included in return statement, causing incorrect output format.
Implement comprehensive error handling in api.ts. Add HTTP status validation, timeout handling, URL validation, and proper error handling for JSON parsing failures.
Add input validation to all utility functions. Validate URL format in fetchData, validate tax rate bounds and amount values in calculateTax, and validate date input in formatDate.
Fix date formatting to be ISO 8601 compliant. Use zero-padding for month and day values. Consider using native toISOString() or Intl.DateTimeFormat API instead of manual formatting.
Add proper rounding for tax calculations to handle floating-point arithmetic issues. Use Math.round() with correct decimal place handling or a dedicated currency library.
Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions explaining parameters, return types, possible exceptions, and usage examples.
Replace string concatenation with template literals for better readability and maintainability. Use modern JavaScript syntax throughout.
Implement request timeouts in api.ts fetchData function using AbortController to prevent indefinite hangs on slow connections.
